2 PLAYERS

SCALEX

  • Red buttons (bottom-left) drive the red car.
  • Blue buttons (bottom-right) drive the blue car.
  • Reverse is as fast as forward and the lap counter counts down (even below zero) while backing.
  • Upper button accelerates, lower button decelerates. Keep pressing it after a stop to reverse.
  • Keyboard: Q/A red, P/L blue.
  • Reset (left) restarts the race.
  • Bulb: night mode with headlights.
  • Two people icon: invite a friend on WhatsApp. Pick the car colour your friend will drive; you drive the other one.
  • Sound switch (right) turns the engines on or off.
  • There is no top speed. Push too hard and the car breaks.
